articles.summary: 3 September 2026, Shanghai – IHG Hotels & Resorts (IHG) is enhancing the guest journey with concert-focused hospitality solutions across Greater China, responding to the growing demand for live entertainment travel. From tailored hotel packages and convenient transport links to exclusive loyalty rewards, IHG is turning concert outings into extended travel experiences – helping guests make the most of their concert journeys beyond the venue.
